# GitHub Copilot DevDays

> An informal evening event for developers, hosted by Knowit Experience in
> Gothenburg. Three short talks — including one from GitHub — on building with
> GitHub Copilot, followed by drinks and conversation. Free to attend, ~17:00–19:00.

Key facts:

- Host: Knowit Experience (https://www.knowit.se/om-knowit/experience/)
- City: Gothenburg, Sweden
- Venue: Vikingsgatan 3, 411 04 Göteborg
- Time: 17:00 – 19:00
- Price: Free
- Format: 3 speakers (one from GitHub), then mingle

## Event

- [Registration (Luma)](https://luma.com/mawlp9c7): Reserve a spot for GitHub Copilot DevDays.
- [About the event](/#about): What to expect from the evening.
- [Agenda](/#agenda): Talk schedule for the evening.
- [Speakers](/#speakers): The three speakers, including a guest from GitHub.
- [Venue](/#venue): Location and directions to Vikingsgatan 3, Göteborg.

## About the host

- [Knowit Experience](https://www.knowit.se/om-knowit/experience/): The digital agency hosting DevDays.
